author: Neubert, M., Ligeti, Z., and Nir, Y.
title: QCD Sum Rule Analysis of the Subleading Isgur-Wise Form Factor $\chi_2(v\cdot v')$
abstract: We present a QCD sum rule calculation of the spin-symmetry violating universal function $\chi_2(v\cdot v')$, which appears at order $1/m_Q$ in the heavy quark expansion of meson form factors. This function vanishes in the standard approximation, where radiative effects are neglected. For the first time, the complete set of diagrams arising at order $\alpha_s$ is evaluated. In particular, we find $\chi_2(1) = -(3.8\pm 0.4)\%$ at zero recoil, indicating that $1/m_Q$ corrections induced by the chromo-magnetic moment operator are small.

data.note: Order-$\alpha_s$ QCD sum rule for $\chi_2(y)$, including the two-loop perturbative, quark-condensate and gluon-condensate contributions. The only quoted number is the zero-recoil value $\chi_2(1)=-(3.8\pm 0.4)\%$, whose error is the variation of $\omega_0$ between 1.7 and 2.3 GeV; the published abstract quotes $\pm 1.1\%$ instead. The perturbative-only estimate $\chi_2^{\mathrm{pert}}(1)\simeq-2.6\%$ and the curves of Figs. 1-2 are not stored, and no correlation is published.
